name: default
description: Generic internal code/work. Conservative: assume semi-trusted internal inputs, normal scale. Use when no more specific profile fits.
provenance: Internal code or content produced within this workspace.
trust: Semi-trusted: not adversarial, but may contain mistakes.
threat_model: Not exposed to untrusted external input by default. If the artifact clearly handles external/user input, treat that input as untrusted and DO flag injection/validation issues with a concrete reachable trigger.
scale: Normal interactive/CLI scale unless the artifact says otherwise.
non_goals: Defending against adversarial inputs that cannot reach this code path
invariants: Do not recommend any change that loses or corrupts valid data to satisfy a non-functional concern
exclusions: Denial of Service / algorithmic-complexity / CPU or memory exhaustion — advisory unless you name a concrete reachable trigger at real scale
Generic input-validation hardening without a proven reachable impact
